verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own product page and TechPowerUp both confirm the RTX 5090's 32GB GDDR7 VRAM and 1.792 TB/s bandwidth, which are the core published specs needed to argue for local LLM inference feasibility, and community sources note 'potent AI performance.' However, 32GB is tight for a genuine 70B-class model even at 4-bit quantization (typically ~35-40GB), and no evidence in the pack actually confirms a 70B model running successfully on this card or gives concrete quantized-inference throughput numbers. Missing for 10: explicit benchmarks or reports of a 70B quantized model running on a single 5090, discussion of quantization level needed to fit in 32GB, and independent hands-on LLM inference testing.
